title: How to Build a Community Platform with AI: Complete 2026 Guide
summary: Community platforms need member profiles, discussion boards, events, and admin moderation. Learn exactly what features to build — and how to ship a custom one in a weekend with Blink.
body_markdown: A working scaffold with member auth, discussion threads, and an events calendar takes 2-4 hours of prompting and iteration. Adding moderation tools, notifications, and a resource library adds another half-day. A full-featured launch-ready platform takes a focused weekend.
